# Vivid Partners

> Vivid Partners is a leading private venture holding company based in Toronto, Canada. We are dedicated to acquiring, strengthening, and building exceptional businesses for the long term. We believe enduring companies are built through patient ownership, disciplined execution, and trusted partnerships.

## About

Vivid Partners is a private investment firm focused on disciplined capital allocation across growth equity, private credit, and real assets, guided by long-term conviction and hands-on partnership. Headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, we invest in and partner with high-quality businesses across North America and internationally, with portfolio companies in Waterloo, Oshawa, Winnipeg, Burlington (Vermont), London (United Kingdom), and San Francisco (California).

## Team

- **Mithun Narendran** — Co-Founder of Vivid Partners. Mithun leads the firm's investment strategy and capital allocation decisions.
- **Abishan Ravinthran** — Co-Founder of Vivid Partners. Abishan oversees business development and partner relationships.
- **Vathusan Udayakumaran** — Chief Operating Officer (COO) of Vivid Partners. Vathusan manages day-to-day operations and client relations.
- **Rathusan Udayakumaran** — Equity Research Analyst at Vivid Partners. Rathusan conducts equity research and financial analysis.

## Portfolio Companies

- **Vivid Agency** — A Toronto-based web development and consulting practice, acquired by Vivid Partners, with the same team continuing to run it. Services include web development, paid media, SEO, and social media management.
- **Kora** — An all-in-one CRM and marketing automation platform, acquired by Vivid Partners to invest in its growth.
- **Keyflow** — An early-stage AI startup based in San Francisco. Vivid Partners provided early-stage capital.

## Investment Focus

Vivid Partners focuses on growth equity, private credit, and real assets. We seek to partner with founders and business owners who value long-term stewardship over short-term outcomes. Our approach emphasizes patient ownership, operational support, and preserving the culture and identity of the businesses we acquire.
